messages:
sam: heads up — after the npm publish of @redwood/sdk v1.4.0 a few of our sample apps (next/edge and worker runtimes) started throwing module errors in onboarding tests :facepalm:

sam: error snippet from Vercel Edge: `TypeError: default is not a function` when importing SDK in edge handler. Node builds are fine.

sam: suspects the recent export-map tweak we did to normalize the cjs/esm entrypoints. repro below.

sam: repro steps:
1) yarn add @redwood/sdk@1.4.0
2) in an edge worker: `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`
3) runtime throws on cold start

sam: package.json exports in the release branch: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": "./dist/index.js",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}```

devon: hmm — that single-string exports will make Node treat it as conditional ambiguous for ESM/require. Edge workers (and some bundlers) expect explicit import vs require targets. we should have conditional `import`/`require` entries.

anya: also noticed types changed — consumers on TS projects now get `export =` vs `export default` mismatch. got a couple of tickets this morning.

mike: can confirm. our sample-app CI (edge runner) started failing in the onboarding checks after the release. attaching the failing log: ```
Error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'request')
 at Module.fetcher (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js:12:34)
 at runtime handler (/workspace/edge/handler.mjs:7:12)
```

devon: quick workaround: revert exports to conditional mapping: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}```
That will ensure ESM import resolution on edges and keep CJS for older node require consumers.

sam: @devon can you publish a patch if we agree? we have a few customers hitting onboarding friction — want to minimize churn.

anya: also propose we add a tiny `edge.test.mjs` in the sample-app repo that does a bare import check on CI to catch this earlier.

mike: agreed. I'll add a matrix job for edge runtime smoke on sample-apps. low overhead.

devon: publishing a quick 1.4.1 now with corrected exports + a `types` revert. will link the release here in ~5m.

deploy-bot: release-1.4.1 build started (job id r-4812) :rocket:

sam: thanks. after we patch, we should also update the changelog with a one-line note about "exports map changed — caused ESM edge import break" so devs searching won't get surprised.

anya: and open a small DX doc on recommended package.json export patterns for edge compatibility (I can draft).

mike: once release is up i'll run the sample-app matrix.

devon: ok published 1.4.1 — fixed exports and types, also added a tiny note in changelog. https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/sdk/v/1.4.1

sam: retesting now against the failing sample.

sam: ✅ sample app onboarding passed on edge smoke. thanks devon! :tada:

anya: filing follow-up tasks:
- DX guide on export maps (priority P2)
- Add edge import smoke to sample-app CI (mike)
- Add unit test for package export permutations (devex infra)

mike: created PR for CI matrix job: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/123

devon: leaving a note in the release that consumers should prefer `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` for ESM, and `const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk')` still works for CJS. we'll also add a migration blurb in the SDK README.

sam: perfect. thanks all — lesson: export map changes need a tiny compatibility checklist (node, bundlers, edge). saved by fast patch :thumbsup:
